# v0.8.0: DuckDB Module Migration Tracking Issue

## 🎯 Overview

This epic tracks the migration from deprecated `github.com/marcboeker/go-duckdb/v2` to the official `github.com/duckdb/duckdb-go` module for v0.8.0 release.

**Target Release**: Q1 2026  
**Priority**: High  
**Implementation Plan**: [docs/V0.8.0_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md](../docs/V0.8.0_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md)

---

## 🎯 Success Criteria

### Must-Have

- ✅ All existing tests pass
- ✅ Zero performance regression (±5%)
- ✅ All 5 platforms supported
- ✅ 100% GORM compliance
- ✅ Documentation complete
- ✅ Migration guide available

### Performance Targets

- Query Latency: ≤ 5ms
- Connection Time: ≤ 10ms
- Memory Usage: ≤ 50MB
- Concurrent Queries: ≥ 1000/s

### Quality Metrics

- Code Coverage: ≥ 85%
- Linting Errors: 0
- Security Vulnerabilities: 0

---

## ⚠️ Risks & Mitigation

| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|
| API Incompatibility | High | Comprehensive API analysis |
| Platform-Specific Issues | Medium | Early platform testing |
| Performance Regression | High | Continuous benchmarking |
| GORM Callback Changes | Medium | Extensive callback testing |
